Entries.Text: Part Transfer
Part Transfer

Copies map pieces and objects from another loaded map into the selected map. Map pieces belong to their map, so each map piece model is ported into the selected map under a new ID; the map textures the parts need are copied into the selected map's area.
Load a map and select it in the map list: it is the map the parts are copied into.
Target Map
The selected map, which the parts are copied into.
Source Map
The loaded map the parts are copied from.
Pick a loaded map to copy parts from.
The source is the selected map. Pick another map, or select the map to copy into in the map list.
Both maps read their map pieces from {0}, so map pieces keep their models and nothing is ported.
This game keeps every map piece of a map in one file, so map pieces can't be ported; only objects can be transferred.
Options
How the copied parts are placed and named, and whether textures are copied.
Move to the placement orb

Move the copied parts, as a group, to the viewport's placement orb. Off keeps their coordinates, which are relative to each map's origin, so parts from a map with a different origin can land far away.
Rename map pieces after their new model
Name each ported map piece part after its new model, in the game's style (m000500_0000). Off keeps the source names (made unique).
Copy missing textures
Copy the map textures the parts use that the target area's texture binders don't hold, from the binders that do.
This game's map pieces and objects use the shared asset textures, so there are no textures to copy.
Map textures aren't copied for this game. Copy the textures the parts need by hand.
